title: Mayabini
desc: When a mysterious presence murders several workers in a forest, an investigation begins to find the perpetrators behind the crime.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Laxmi, a milkmaid, falls in love with Kanchan, an influential zamindar's son. Things take a tragic turn when his family disapproves of their alliance.

title: Tomai Pabo Bole
desc: Two neighbouring families are embroiled in a bitter rivalry. However, in an interesting turn of events, the son of one family falls in love with the daughter of the other.

title: Chowdhury Paribar
desc: A man expends all his efforts to keep his family together. However, his wife and older brother thwart his plans by creating rifts within the family.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.

title: Mahajan
desc: A powerful landowner conducts his business and lives his life with cruelty. However, various circumstances influence him to change his nature and tactics over time.
